decisions: Minutes of the July 12, 2025 board meeting approved unanimously.
Reallocation of $150,000 to a dedicated client retention fund approved; co-managed by Pierre Dubois and Aiyana Park effective immediately.

Service scope expansion for Northwind Partners approved; Aiyana Park authorized to begin specialist consultant recruitment by September 1, 2025, with a formal project plan due at the September board meeting.
Operations infrastructure upgrade approved; Aiyana Park authorized to spend up to $95,000 on a new unified project management platform, with migration completed before January 1, 2026.
External HR consultancy commissioned for succession planning with a budget cap of $40,000; engagement to begin October 1, 2025, overseen by Margaret Holvan.
Next board meeting confirmed for September 13, 2025, at 9:00 AM.
